title: echinopsis aurea var. callochrysea
intro: Echinopsis aurea var. callochrysea, commonly known as the Golden Torch cactus, is a species of cactus belonging to the Echinopsis genus. It is a type of succulent plant known for its vibrant orange-red flowers, which are often used to make dyes and medicines. The Golden Torch cactus has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including pain, inflammation, and infections, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds.
